notes.title: Beyond your Fear - Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
It's been a year since I released this game, and I want to thank everyone who supported this project. From the buggy launch to the addition of different languages, achievements, and (almost) smooth performance, your support has been invaluable. To celebrate this milestone, I wanted to enhance its performance and graphical appeal even further, as well as make some puzzles more obvious (by numerous requests).

In addition, this game will probably receive two content updates this year (featuring graphical and technical improvements), plus controller support. Also, enjoy the biggest discount in the history of this game: 50% off.

So as usual, any suggestions for game improvements and bug reports are wholeheartedly welcome!!

notes.title: Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
Improvements:

 Huge performance boost
 Fixed weird shading interactions
 Made riddles even more intuitive
 Improved lighting for more realistic representation
 Fixed an item interaction that prevented seeing different outcomes from one of the items

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.1.1 (30th June)
notes.notes:
General Changes:
 
 Improved overall game performance, resulting in smoother gameplay and reduced lag. Enjoy a more seamless and immersive gaming experience.
 Fixed UI intersection for Lens and Diary: Resolved an issue where the Lens and Diary interfaces overlapped, causing visual confusion. The interfaces now display properly, ensuring clear and unobstructed access to both features.
 Added text hint for easy readability of the diary, enhancing the user interface. Important information is now presented with better clarity and navigation.
 Made riddles more intuitive to solve, providing a more engaging puzzle-solving experience for players.
 Now, when choosing the "Take mask" option, the mask goes directly to your inventory. This streamlines inventory management, saving time and effort.
 Added cursor change to make interactable objects more apparent. Enjoy improved object visibility, making it easier to identify and interact with items of interest during gameplay.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.1.0 (18th May)
notes.notes:
General Changes:


 Improved overall game performance, resulting in smoother gameplay and reduced lag.
 Increased the visibility and accessibility of certain items, making them easier to locate during gameplay.

Bug Fixes:


 Resolved an issue with the placement of secret box statues, ensuring they appear correctly in their designated locations.
 Fixed a bug that caused players to get stuck in corners of the game environment, allowing for smoother movement and exploration.


Additional Notes:


 I value your feedback! If you have encountered any additional bugs or issues, please don't hesitate to report them below. Your input helps me improve the game further.
